title: Elephant Parade Dreamscape
description: A surreal fantasy scene shows a line of ornate mechanical elephants with howdahs marching through a field of purple lavender and vibrant poppies. A glowing spectral child figure with a large white lily emerging from their head emits beams of light toward floating open books containing trees, set against a stained-glass sky with a radiant sun and cherry blossoms.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of ornate mechanical elephants with decorative howdahs marching in a line through a vibrant field of purple lavender and red poppies. A translucent glowing child-like figure with a giant white lily blooming from their head floats in the sky, emitting bright yellow beams of light towards several floating open books that contain living trees inside. The background features a dramatic stained-glass sky with a radiant golden sun, purple and red mosaic patterns, cherry blossoms, and sparkling particles. Dreamlike and whimsical atmosphere.
medium: digital painting with stained glass elements
